name: Ezer
description: Adam's spellsquire who raises Jared and dies in the fall of Castle Melmereth.

description_citations.text: "The Shadow Mage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared grows up a beggar in Arathoxia raised by Ezer.
timeline.quote: brought up by his father's spellsquire Ezer

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adam Carthalion is defeated by Ravidel at Ephren, entrusts his spelltrove and infant Jared to Ezer, and obliterates Ravidel's barge and himself with Inferno.
timeline.quote: He then casts an Inferno spell, obliterating Ravidel's barge and himself along with it.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A treefolk defends the sleeping infant Jared from wolves in the forest of Krisylthas.
timeline.quote: the tree they are resting against is a treefolk

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scarlet Vizier rebuffs Ezer at the Carthalion estate while Liana, disguised as a child, watches.
timeline.quote: is rebuffed by the Scarlet Vizier , who calls him a liar and throws him and the infant into the street

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seven years later Jared disintegrates a berserker sent by Ravidel with a scroll from his father's spelltrove, and Ezer names him the Shadow Mage.
timeline.quote: Ezer joyfully notes that Jared now has access to red magic, and names the child The Shadow Mage .

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freed by the vizier's death, Liana is able to act against Ravidel and enters the castle with Ezer.
timeline.quote: this newly discovered freedom from her oath finally enables Liana to take direct action against Ravidel

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narok kills Nikko and Jared annihilates Narok, then crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle; Ezer dies, and the castle explodes from Liana's sorcery.
timeline.quote: Jared crushes the Black Lotus and summons a Shivan Dragon
